'''Old Morta''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who founded the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Blatant Beks]] along with [[Bangcap (Weequay)|Bangcap]]. She led the [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] while Bangcap led the [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]]. By the time of the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]], Old Morta had left the Beks.<ref name="Blast" />
